html:
Improvements

  • All poems are now written by people in the room—machine-generated lines have been removed.
  • Late joiners see their own waiting character outlined, so it’s clearer who you are before the round starts.
  • The app now runs on a faster hosting setup, making room loading and transitions snappier.
  • Avatars have been refreshed with a new cast of characters.

html:
Improvements

  • Private poem downloads and social previews are working again.
  • Guest sessions now stay separate between requests, so joining and playing as a guest is more reliable.
  • The home page and shared help now load faster with a lighter, native feel.
  • If a module fails to load, Linejam recovers automatically with a fresh request instead of leaving you stuck.
markdown:
## Improvements

- Private poem downloads and social previews are working again.
- Guest sessions now stay separate between requests, so joining and playing as a guest is more reliable.
- The home page and shared help now load faster with a lighter, native feel.
- If a module fails to load, Linejam recovers automatically with a fresh request instead of leaving you stuck.
